Senses.Explanation: The opening half of Muzhou's doubled mourning formula — with the great matter not yet clear, mourn as for parents — carried from his address to the assembly through centuries of re-deployment. Muzhou Daoming's address to the assembly fixed the doubled line — unclear, mourn as for parents; settled, mourn as for parents — raised verbatim in Baiyan Fu's collection of old-case commentaries; Zhongfeng Mingben absorbs both lines into his own ode and answers with mountains and rivers level as a palm, a straight official road, iron walls and silver mountains standing ahead for whoever asks about fortune; and Yezhu Fuhui proclaims the pair himself, concedes the unclear, then asks why the settled too should mourn, answering that at the time he only spoke of hair long and short — burn it and you know the ground was never level. Yunwai Xingze opens his small meeting with time flying and the seasons flowing, the great matter not yet clear, mourning as for parents, then asks who knows the light that never moves and the seasons that never flow; Yongjue Yuanxian warns that whether the great matter is yet unclear or one claims it settled, even overturning the world and toppling the buddhas and ancestors leaves the poison not yet dispelled; Guxue Zhenzhe names the unclear a knot — seizing empty space alive and knocking out blood — and the settled a loosing, the gnat swallowing the eastern sea; Chaozong Tongren, at the memorial service for a monk's parents, turns the doubled mourning into matched verses on the groundless dark craving and the wisdom that is idle furniture; and Yulin Tongxiu, staff raised, grants the old one's line and presses further — the settled still mourn, how much more the unclear — calling for the digging to be real digging and the waking real waking, food and sleep forgotten, to know one's own vast mind before the first thought.
